company.name: Battlemap
company.shortDescription: Battlemap integrates features from combat video games into the real-life airsoft, paintball, and laser tag matches.
company.description: Battlemap bridges the gap between digital and physical gaming by bringing the core features of combat video games to a mobile application for use during real-life games of airsoft, paintball, and laser tag.  Gamers will now be able to see a satellite overview of the entire playing field and the real-time locations of teammates and opponents as they play.  Other features include team-restricted Bluetooth communication lines, as well as un-lockable special abilities and game modes to create the most immersive, real-life gaming experience possible.  Instead of technology limiting the capabilities of a video game as it does in gaming consoles, Overwatch enhances a physical game using nothing more than a smartphone.
